// UnpackInput attempts to decode the provided call data using contract method definitions.
func (tuple *Tuple) UnpackInput(callData []byte) (any, error) {
	if len(callData) < 4 {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TupleABI.Methods["func1"].ID[:4]) {
		return tupleUnpackInput[Tuple_Func1_Input]("func1", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TupleABI.Methods["func2"].ID[:4]) {
		return tupleUnpackInput[Tuple_Func2_Input]("func2", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TupleABI.Methods["func3"].ID[:4]) {
		return tupleUnpackInput[Tuple_Func3_Input]("func3", callData)
	}
	return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
}

// UnpackEvent unpacks event log based on topic0.
func (tuple *Tuple) UnpackEvent(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	for _, item := range tupleEventUnpackers {
		if item.id == log.Topics[0] {
			return item.unpack(log)
		}
	}
	return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
}

type tupleEventUnpacker struct {
	id     common.Hash
	unpack func(*types.Log) (any, error)
}

type tupleErrorUnpacker struct {
	id     [4]byte
	unpack func([]byte) (any, error)
}

var tupleEventUnpackers = []tupleEventUnpacker{
	{id: common.HexToHash("0x18d6e66efa53739ca6d13626f35ebc700b31cced3eddb50c70bbe9c082c6cd00"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (Tuple_TupleEvent_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
	{id: common.HexToHash("0x88833a3455c364501b6a838291e9240d528d80babaa9916b2cba73f4f95b8d50"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (Tuple_TupleEvent2_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
}

func tupleMust[T any](val T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return val
}

func tupleConvertType[T any](value any) T {
	return *abi.ConvertType(value, new(T)).(*T)
}

func tupleCallRaw(ctx context.Context, client bind.ContractCaller, addr common.Address, opts *bind.CallOpts, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var callOpts bind.CallOpts
	if opts != nil {
		callOpts = *opts
	}
	callOpts.Context = ctx
	return bind.NewBoundContract(addr, *_TupleABI, client, nil, nil).CallRaw(&callOpts, input)
}

func tupleUnpackInput[T any](name string, callData []byte) (*T, error) {
	method, ok := _TupleABI.Methods[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("method '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(callData) < 4 || !bytes.Equal(callData[:4], method.ID[:4]) {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	arguments, err := method.Inputs.Unpack(callData[4:])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	input := new(T)
	any(input).(interface{ unpack([]any) }).unpack(arguments)
	return input, nil
}

func tupleUnpackEvent[T any](name string, log *types.Log) (*T, error) {
	event, ok := _TupleABI.Events[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("event '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	if log.Topics[0] != event.ID {
		return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
	}
	var values []any
	if len(log.Data) > 0 {
		var err error
		values, err = event.Inputs.Unpack(log.Data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	out := new(T)
	eventData := any(out).(interface {
		unpack([]any)
		setRaw(*types.Log)
	})
	eventData.unpack(values)
	var indexed abi.Arguments
	for _, arg := range event.Inputs {
		if arg.Indexed {
			indexed = append(indexed, arg)
		}
	}
	if err := abi.ParseTopics(out, indexed, log.Topics[1:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	eventData.setRaw(log)
	return out, nil
}
